items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Professor Umphrey, James Umphrey, was our instructor... he advised me to buy a trombone. And I agreed to do so. And he bought me a trombone... He told me that it wasn't much, no difference in the music much. Just you had to learn the precessions and learn how to blow.

ctx.x: I see. And what were you playing?
I played bass violin. And Professor Umphrey, James Umphrey, was our instructor. And he lived in New Orleans. We lived in the parish.
Just about where was that in the Jefferson?
